agency.name: Department of Mental Health and Addiction Services (DMHAS)

narrNote: CTARR appears on NARR's official affiliate list; it is Connecticut's NARR affiliate. DMHAS publishes the list of CTARR-certified sober living homes, and certified homes are eligible for state-funded referrals.
notes: Agency identity from SAMHSA's SSA directory (Department of Mental Health and Addiction Services); the DMHAS page was fetched with phone 860-418-7000 published (ct.gov content is now served under portal.ct.gov). The ACTION Line is DMHAS's 24/7 adult crisis line — 1-800-HOPE-135 (1-800-467-3135), also reachable by dialing 211 — documented on the linked DMHAS 'Finding Services' page and in DMHAS's launch announcement. Medicaid SUD coverage runs through the Department of Social Services' Section 1115 Substance Use Disorder Demonstration for HUSKY Health (Connecticut Medicaid/CHIP); the linked page is DSS's official demonstration page. CTARR historically also used the ctarr.org domain; ctrecoveryresidences.org is its live site and was fetched and verified. countyDirectory is null: Connecticut has no county governments.
